chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as an attribute of Allah’s comprehensive perception, distinguishing it from human limited views. This aligns with the Shia theological principle that all divine decrees, whether perceived as joy or trial, are ultimately rooted in wisdom and goodness (*al-Hikmah*), reinforcing the believer's trust in God's absolute benevolence.
